primary_task: Fine-tune vision models (object detection, image classification, SAM/SAM2) by submitting training jobs to Hugging Face Jobs with results pushed to the Hub.

requirements.name: huggingface (Pro/Team/Enterprise, write token)
requirements.evidence: Hugging Face Account with Pro ... plan (Jobs require paid plan); Authenticated login

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: Dataset must exist on Hub; submit job; push_to_hub

requirements.name: job submission
requirements.evidence: Submit using hf_jobs MCP tool (preferred) or HfApi().run_uv_job()
requirements.check: session MCP list; pip download --no-deps huggingface_hub
requirements.observed: hf_jobs MCP not connected; huggingface_hub installable (but needs huggingface.co)

notes: Training runs on HF cloud GPUs, so no local GPU required.
